info.name: Informed Consents CRUD
info.description:
# Informed Consents API

Full CRUD for the `informed_consent` table with multipart **signature** file upload on create/update.

## Auth
- Header: `API-KEY` (required)
- Body/query: `token`, `requester` (required on all endpoints)

## Signature file (VM4)
- Field name: `signature`
- Type: file (form-data)
- Allowed: PNG, JPEG, JPG, PDF
- Max size: 5 MB
- Uploaded via `upload_to_vm4()` to path `assets/informed_consents/{id}/`
- DB `signature` column stores the **full VM4 URL** (e.g. `https://file.myt-emr.com/assets/informed_consents/1/....png`)
- GET returns the same value as both `signature` and `signature_url`

## Multi-branch sync
Create, update, and delete propagate to all branch databases:
- `master` (0), `mobile` (1), `oakridge` (2), `mactan` (3), `consolacion` (4), `mantlewood` (7)

- Returned `informed_consent_id` is the **master** insert ID
- Signature VM4 URL is synced to all branch DB rows with that ID
- **GET** reads from **master only**
- Create/update run a consistency check; mismatch returns `400`:
  `"Data inconsistency detected between master and {branch}."`

request.description:
## GET `/informed_consents/get`

Returns informed consent records with optional filters.

### Query params
| Param | Required | Notes |
|-------|----------|-------|
| `token` | yes | Auth token |
| `requester` | yes | User id |
| `informed_consent_id` | no | Filter by id |
| `term` | no | Search first/middle/last name |
| `page` | no | 1-based page |
| `data_size` | no | Page size |

### Success response
```json
{
  "size": 1,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "first_name": "Juan",
      "last_name": "Dela Cruz",
      "signature": "abc123.png",
      "signature_url": "http://localhost/.../assets/informed_consents/1/abc123.png"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Multi-branch
Reads from **master database only**.

### Signature URL
`signature` and `signature_url` are the full VM4 URL (not a local path).

## POST `/informed_consents/create`

Creates an informed consent record. Use **form-data** (not raw JSON) so the signature can be sent as a file.

### Required form fields
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `token` | text | Auth token |
| `requester` | text | User id |
| `first_name` | text | NOT NULL in DB |
| `last_name` | text | NOT NULL in DB |

### Optional form fields
| Field | Type | Notes |
|-------|------|-------|
| `middle_name` | text | |
| `date_of_birth` | text | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `is_pregnant` | text | 0 or 1 |
| `signature` | **file** | PNG/JPEG/JPG/PDF, max 5 MB |

### Signature file setup in Postman
1. Set body type to **form-data**
2. Add key `signature`, change type from Text to **File**
3. Click **Select Files** and choose `signature.png` (or your signature image)

### Success response
```json
{
  "informed_consent_id": 1,
  "message": "informed consent added successfully."
}
```

### Multi-branch
Inserts the same row into master plus mobile, oakridge, mactan, consolacion, and mantlewood. Signature filename is synced to all branch DBs after upload.

### Signature (VM4)
File is uploaded to VM4 via `upload_to_vm4()`. The full VM4 URL is stored in `signature` on all branch databases.

request.description:
## POST `/informed_consents/update`

Updates an informed consent record. Use **form-data** when uploading a new signature file.

### Required
- `token`, `requester`, `informed_consent_id`

### Optional fields
Any of `first_name`, `last_name`, `middle_name`, `date_of_birth`, `is_pregnant` — only sent fields are updated.

### Signature file (optional on update)
- Key: `signature` (type: File)
- If provided, replaces the existing file on disk and updates the DB filename
- Allowed: PNG, JPEG, JPG, PDF; max 5 MB

### Success response
```json
{
  "informed_consent_id": 1,
  "message": "informed consent updated successfully."
}
```

### Multi-branch
Updates the same `informed_consent_id` on all branch databases. Optional new signature file replaces the on-disk file and syncs the filename to all branches.

### Signature (VM4)
Optional new signature file is uploaded to VM4; the new full URL replaces `signature` on all branch databases.

## POST `/informed_consents/delete`

Soft-deletes an informed consent (`is_deleted = 1`).

### Required JSON body
- `token`, `requester`, `informed_consent_id`

### Success response
```json
{
  "message": "informed consent is deleted."
}
```

### Multi-branch
Soft-deletes (`is_deleted = 1`) on all branch databases.
